title: Contemperation
summary: CONTEMPERATION, noun 1. The act of reducing a quality by admixture of the contrary; the act of moderating or tempering. 2. Temperament; proportionate mixture; as the contemperament of humors in differ

inlines.v: CONTEMPERATION, noun 1. The act of reducing a quality by admixture of the contrary; the act of moderating or tempering. 2. Temperament; proportionate mixture; as the contemperament of humors in different bodies. [Instead of these words, temper and temperament are now generally used.]
